images.shows: SLC-40 from the air, 2010 (SpaceX): apron, launch mount, four lightning towers in two pairs, hangar and ring road
Falcon 9 vertical on SLC-40, 2015 (SpaceX): lattice erector beside the rocket, raised launch mount, lightning towers with masts and wires
SLC-40 in 2024 (NASA/Keegan Barber): rocket being raised on the erector, the black access tower, both pairs of lightning towers with masts and catenary wires
Crew-9 Falcon 9 on SLC-40, 2024 (NASA/Keegan Barber): erector lattice and arms beside the stack, access tower with its swing arm and white room
Falcon 9 climbing at dusk, 2024 (U.S. Space Force): the exhaust glow and trail at altitude
A landed Falcon 9 first stage standing on its legs after flight, 2015 (SpaceX), sooted tanks and interstage
The engine section of a flown first stage on display: eight Merlin bells round a centre one, leg hinges and struts
